Processo de Inicialização Segura

A cryptographic method that ensures only authorized software can be loaded on avionics systems during startup (EASA, ICAO Doc 10117).

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Processo de Inicialização Segura?

In this glossary, Processo de Inicialização Segura refers to: A cryptographic method that ensures only authorized software can be loaded on avionics systems during startup (EASA, ICAO Doc 10117).

How is Processo de Inicialização Segura used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "A aviônica passou pelo Processo de Inicialização Segura, confirmando que nenhum software não autorizado estava presente na inicialização."

Definition

A cryptographic method that ensures only authorized software can be loaded on avionics systems during startup (EASA, ICAO Doc 10117).

Operational example

The avionics passed the Secure Boot Process, confirming no unauthorized software was present at power-up.

Localized term
